title: owwa-cruiserweight
label: Maxwell "The Dynasty" Biggs

won.source: Automatically awarded by the promotion's own president as the only cruiserweight among the Battle of the Best's final four.

note: Retained the title in successful defenses through mid-March.

title: owwa-cruiserweight
label: Luke "The Puke" Harry

won.source: Billed as "the first ever OWWA cruiser champion" on the promotion's own first card (23 February 1999); no document records when or how he won it.

note: Did not survive to the final four of the promotion's own Battle of the Best battle royal, ending his reign.

title: owwa-united-states
label: Anaconda

won.source: Awarded under the Battle of the Best's own stipulation after Anaconda lost the Heavyweight title decider and chose the United States title over the Hardcore title.

note: Retained the title against Reaper in a defense billed on the promotion's own 9 March card.

title: owwa-heavyweight
label: Amen "The Irish Icon" O'Mighty

won.source: Billed as the promotion's own first Heavyweight Champion of the World after defeating Anaconda in a weapons-strewn cage match, with help from a corrupt management faction that had orchestrated the tournament in his favor.

note: Retained the title against an outmatched challenger, Zane, later the same week.

title: owwa-hardcore
label: Decapitator

won.source: Awarded under the Battle of the Best's own stipulation as the title left over once Anaconda claimed the United States title.

note: Still billed as champion through the promotion's own mid-March cards, carrying the belt to the ring.
